segments.ZEP.1.1-3: The LORD says he will sweep away everything on earth
segments.ZEP.1.4-6: The LORD will punish Judah for worshiping idols
segments.ZEP.1.7-9: The Day of the LORD is near, and he will punish leaders
segments.ZEP.1.10-11: Jerusalem will wail and its merchants will be silenced
segments.ZEP.1.12-13: The LORD will punish people who think he does nothing
segments.ZEP.1.14-16: The great Day of the LORD will be a day of wrath
segments.ZEP.1.17-18: Silver and gold cannot save sinners on the LORD’s Day
segments.ZEP.2.4-5: The LORD will destroy the Philistine cities
segments.ZEP.2.6-7: The coast will belong to the remnant of Judah
segments.ZEP.2.8-9: The LORD will punish Moab and Ammon for insulting Israel
segments.ZEP.2.12-14: The LORD will strike Cush and destroy Assyria
segments.ZEP.2.15-15: Nineveh thought it was safe but became a ruin
segments.ZEP.3.3-4: Jerusalem’s leaders, prophets and priests are corrupt
segments.ZEP.3.5-5: The LORD is righteous, but the unjust have no shame
segments.ZEP.3.6-7: The LORD punished the nations, but Jerusalem did not learn
segments.ZEP.3.8-8: The LORD will gather nations and pour out his anger
segments.ZEP.3.9-11: The LORD will purify the peoples and remove the proud
segments.ZEP.3.12-13: The LORD will leave a humble people who trust him
segments.ZEP.3.14-16: Zion should sing because the LORD removed punishment
segments.ZEP.3.17-18: The LORD is mighty to save and rejoices over Zion
segments.ZEP.3.19-20: The LORD will gather the scattered and give Israel fame
